_about: PromptState::prepend_text inserted bytes at offset 0 and manually shifted cpos by inserted.len(), but did not touch vim's visual_anchor. When EscAction::Unqueue prepended a queued message while the user was in Visual mode, the anchor stayed at its old absolute offset and ended up mid-codepoint (mid-attachment-marker) once the prefix straddled a boundary it used to sit on.
_fix: fix(input): shift vim visual_anchor when prepend_text inserts a prefix
